summary.en-US: 64-bit Android port and recreation of the classic Flappy Bird game.

description.en-US: FlappyB64bitAndroid is a source-available recreation of the original Flappy Bird game, modernized to support 64-bit Android architecture. Designed for smooth performance on newer Android devices where older 32-bit apps are no longer supported, it offers the traditional arcade gameplay without ads or bloatware.
